name: Chen Hengzhe
shortBio: Chinese historian, New Culture Movement philosopher, and China’s first female university professor who synthesized critical Western historiography with Chinese humanistic inquiry to reimagine gender, culture, and modernity.
centralQuestion: How can modern Chinese thinkers critically integrate Western scientific historiography with indigenous moral humanism without cultural erasure?

keyWorks.title: History of Western Civilization (Xiyang Shi)
keyWorks.description: Influential vernacular Chinese historiography interpreting Europe’s intellectual transformations for May Fourth readers.

keyWorks.title: The Chinese Woman and Other Essays
keyWorks.description: Sociological essays analyzing family reform, women’s intellectual autonomy, and educational modernization in Republican China.
